name: ChatGPT
description_cn: 通用对话与写作助手
description_en: General-purpose assistant for brainstorming and writing
detailed_description_cn: ChatGPT是由OpenAI开发的大型语言模型，基于GPT（Generative Pre-trained Transformer）架构。它能够进行自然语言对话，回答问题，协助写作，编程，翻译，总结文本等多种任务。ChatGPT通过大量文本数据训练，具备强大的语言理解和生成能力，是目前最受欢迎的AI助手之一。
detailed_description_en: ChatGPT is a large language model developed by OpenAI, based on the GPT (Generative Pre-trained Transformer) architecture. It can engage in natural language conversations, answer questions, assist with writing, programming, translation, text summarization, and many other tasks.

name: Midjourney
description_cn: 高质量文生图与风格化创作
description_en: High-quality text-to-image and stylized creation
detailed_description_cn: Midjourney是一款领先的AI图像生成工具，专注于创造高质量、艺术性强的图像。通过简单的文字描述，Midjourney能够生成令人惊叹的艺术作品、插画、概念设计等。该工具以其独特的艺术风格和出色的图像质量而闻名，是艺术家、设计师和创意工作者的首选AI绘画工具。
detailed_description_en: Midjourney is a leading AI image generation tool that focuses on creating high-quality, artistic images. Through simple text descriptions, Midjourney can generate stunning artwork, illustrations, concept designs, and more.

name: Claude
description_cn: 长文理解与方案撰写见长
description_en: Great at long-form understanding and drafting
detailed_description_cn: Claude是由Anthropic开发的AI助手，以其出色的长文本理解能力和高质量的内容生成而著称。Claude在处理复杂文档、深度分析、创意写作等方面表现优异，特别适合需要深度思考和详细分析的任务。
detailed_description_en: Claude is an AI assistant developed by Anthropic, known for its excellent long-text understanding capabilities and high-quality content generation. Claude excels at handling complex documents, in-depth analysis, and creative writing.

name: DALL-E
description_cn: 生成高质量的图像，基于文本描述
description_en: Generates high-quality images based on text descriptions
detailed_description_cn: DALL-E是OpenAI开发的AI图像生成模型，能够根据文本描述创建原创、逼真的图像和艺术作品。DALL-E可以理解复杂的概念组合，生成从未存在过的图像，是创意工作者和设计师的强大工具。
detailed_description_en: DALL-E is an AI image generation model developed by OpenAI that can create original, realistic images and art from text descriptions. DALL-E can understand complex concept combinations and generate images that have never existed before.

name: Stable Diffusion
description_cn: 开源文生图生态（SDXL/SD3）
description_en: Open-source T2I ecosystem (SDXL/SD3)
detailed_description_cn: Stable Diffusion是一个开源的文本到图像生成模型，由Stability AI开发。它提供了强大的图像生成能力，支持多种风格和用途，从艺术创作到商业设计都能胜任。作为开源项目，它拥有活跃的社区和丰富的扩展功能。
detailed_description_en: Stable Diffusion is an open-source text-to-image generation model developed by Stability AI. It provides powerful image generation capabilities, supporting various styles and uses, from artistic creation to commercial design.

name: 纳米AI搜索
description_cn: 360推出的多模态AI搜索工具
description_en: Multi-modal AI search tool by 360
detailed_description_cn: 纳米AI搜索是360集团于2024年11月推出的多模态搜索和内容创作工具，支持文字、语音、拍照、视频等多种搜索方式。它集成了先进的AI技术，能够理解和处理多种类型的输入，为用户提供更智能、更便捷的搜索体验。
detailed_description_en: Nanomi AI Search is a multi-modal search and content creation tool launched by 360 Group in November 2024. It supports various search methods including text, voice, photo, and video inputs, providing users with a more intelligent and convenient search experience.

name: Kimi
description_cn: 支持超长文本的AI聊天助手
description_en: AI chat assistant with ultra-long context support
detailed_description_cn: Kimi是由北京月之暗面科技有限公司开发的生成式人工智能聊天机器人，支持超长文本输入，并具备AI自主搜索能力。它能够处理长达200万字的文档，在文档分析、长文本理解和内容创作方面表现出色。
detailed_description_en: Kimi is a generative AI chatbot developed by Beijing Moonshot AI, supporting ultra-long text input and autonomous AI search capabilities. It can handle documents up to 2 million characters, excelling in document analysis and long-text understanding.

name: Google Veo
description_cn: Google最新的文生视频模型
description_en: Google's latest text-to-video model
detailed_description_cn: Veo是由Google DeepMind开发的文字转视频模型，能够根据用户输入的提示生成高质量视频。它支持多种视频风格和格式，可以生成长达一分钟的高清视频内容，是视频创作者的强大工具。
detailed_description_en: Veo is a text-to-video model developed by Google DeepMind that can generate high-quality videos based on user prompts. It supports various video styles and formats, capable of generating HD video content up to one minute long.

name: 智谱清言
description_cn: 智谱华章的多模态AI助手
description_en: Multi-modal AI assistant by Zhipu AI
detailed_description_cn: 智谱清言是由北京智谱华章科技有限公司开发的生成式人工智能聊天机器人，具备AI生成文字、图片、视频等功能。基于GLM模型，它在中文理解和生成方面表现优秀，是国产AI助手的代表之一。
detailed_description_en: Zhipu Qingyan is a generative AI chatbot developed by Beijing Zhipu Huazhang Technology Co., Ltd., with capabilities for AI-generated text, images, and videos. Based on the GLM model, it excels in Chinese language understanding and generation.

name: 豆包
description_cn: 字节跳动的多功能AI智能助手
description_en: ByteDance's multi-functional AI assistant
detailed_description_cn: 豆包是字节跳动公司推出的多功能AI智能助手，支持文本、图像、音视频生成、语音通话、数据分析以及AI驱动的在线搜索功能。它集成了多种AI能力，为用户提供全方位的智能服务体验。
detailed_description_en: Doubao is a multi-functional AI assistant launched by ByteDance, supporting text, image, audio/video generation, voice calls, data analysis, and AI-driven online search functions. It integrates various AI capabilities to provide comprehensive intelligent services.

name: Steve.AI
description_cn: 世界上最快的视频创作工具
description_en: World's fastest way to create videos
detailed_description_cn: Steve.AI是一款革命性的AI视频生成工具，能够将文本脚本快速转换为引人入胜的视频内容。它具备AI生成的语音旁白功能，能够将简单的脚本转化为具有吸引力的视觉内容，大大简化了视频制作流程。
detailed_description_en: Steve.AI is a revolutionary AI video generation tool that can quickly convert text scripts into engaging video content. It features AI-generated voiceovers and turns plain scripts into attractive visual content, greatly simplifying the video production process.
pricing: 免费试用 + 付费订阅

name: Sync.so
description_cn: 视频唇语同步和声音克隆工具
description_en: Video lip sync and voice cloning tool
detailed_description_cn: Sync.so是一款专业的AI视频处理工具，专注于视频中的唇语同步和声音克隆技术。它能够让视频中的人物嘴型与音频完美匹配，并可以克隆特定的声音特征，为视频后期制作提供强大的技术支持。
detailed_description_en: Sync.so is a professional AI video processing tool focused on lip sync and voice cloning technology. It can perfectly match lip movements with audio in videos and clone specific voice characteristics, providing powerful technical support for video post-production.

name: Bitrig
description_cn: 通过自然语言创建iOS应用
description_en: Create iOS apps through natural language
detailed_description_cn: Bitrig是一款创新的iOS应用开发工具，允许用户通过自然语言提示来构建原生iPhone应用程序。它大大降低了移动应用开发的门槛，让没有编程经验的用户也能快速创建功能完整的iOS应用。
detailed_description_en: Bitrig is an innovative iOS app development tool that allows users to build native iPhone applications through natural language prompts. It significantly lowers the barrier to mobile app development, enabling users without programming experience to quickly create fully functional iOS apps.

name: Trace
description_cn: 智能日历应用，自然语言输入
description_en: Smart calendar app with natural language input
detailed_description_cn: Trace是一款智能日历应用，能够将自然语言输入和屏幕截图转换为有组织的事件和任务，并提供智能的日程安排建议。它通过AI技术简化了日程管理，让用户能够更轻松地组织和安排时间。
detailed_description_en: Trace is a smart calendar app that transforms natural language inputs and screenshots into organized events and tasks with intelligent scheduling suggestions. It simplifies schedule management through AI technology, making it easier for users to organize their time.
pricing: 免费试用 + 付费订阅

name: UX Pilot
description_cn: 从文本提示生成UI/UX设计
description_en: Generate UI/UX designs from text prompts
detailed_description_cn: UX Pilot是一款AI驱动的设计工具，能够根据文本提示快速生成专业的UI/UX设计。它帮助设计师和产品经理快速将想法转化为可视化的界面设计，大大提高了设计效率和创意表达能力。
detailed_description_en: UX Pilot is an AI-powered design tool that can quickly generate professional UI/UX designs from text prompts. It helps designers and product managers rapidly transform ideas into visual interface designs, greatly improving design efficiency and creative expression.
pricing: 免费试用 + 付费订阅

name: Manus
description_cn: Monica团队的通用人工智能代理
description_en: Universal AI agent by Monica team
detailed_description_cn: Manus是由Monica团队于2025年3月6日发布的通用人工智能代理产品，能够自主完成复杂任务，如自动搜索、多步骤行动、破解验证码、处理复杂文件，并生成结构化输出，如表格和演示文稿等。Manus代表了AI代理技术的最新突破，能够理解复杂指令并自主执行多步骤任务。
detailed_description_en: Manus is a universal AI agent product released by Monica team on March 6, 2025. It can autonomously complete complex tasks such as automatic searching, multi-step actions, CAPTCHA solving, complex file processing, and generating structured outputs like tables and presentations. Manus represents the latest breakthrough in AI agent technology.

name: Claude 4.1
description_cn: Anthropic最新的大型语言模型
description_en: Anthropic's latest large language model
detailed_description_cn: Claude 4.1是由Anthropic于2025年8月6日发布的最新大型语言模型。作为Claude系列的最新版本，它在安全性、可靠性和人类价值观对齐方面有了显著提升。Claude 4.1专注于创建友善、诚实、无害的人工智能助手，能够协助完成从自然语言理解到复杂问题解决等一系列任务。
detailed_description_en: Claude 4.1 is the latest large language model released by Anthropic on August 6, 2025. As the newest version in the Claude series, it features significant improvements in safety, reliability, and human value alignment. Claude 4.1 focuses on creating helpful, harmless, and honest AI assistants.

name: DeepSeek-V3
description_cn: 深度求索的数学编程专用大模型
description_en: Math and coding specialized large model by DeepSeek
detailed_description_cn: DeepSeek-V3是由深度求索于2024年12月26日发布的人工智能大型语言模型，专门适用于数学、编程和中文等任务。该模型在性能上对标GPT-4o等竞争产品，但训练成本更低，特别在数学推理和代码生成方面表现出色，是国产AI模型的重要突破。
detailed_description_en: DeepSeek-V3 is an AI large language model released by DeepSeek on December 26, 2024, specifically designed for mathematics, coding, and Chinese language tasks. It matches the performance of competitors like GPT-4o but with lower training costs, excelling particularly in mathematical reasoning and code generation.

name: Sider
description_cn: 基于ChatGPT的多功能AI助手
description_en: Multi-functional AI assistant based on ChatGPT
detailed_description_cn: Sider是一款功能强大的AI助手，基于先进的ChatGPT技术，为用户提供即时的AI帮助。它集成了多个AI模型，提升用户的创造力和全面性，帮助用户更智能地处理信息。Sider支持网页侧边栏使用，可以随时随地为用户提供AI支持。
detailed_description_en: Sider is a powerful AI assistant based on advanced ChatGPT technology, providing instant AI help to users. It integrates multiple AI models to enhance user creativity and comprehensiveness, helping users handle information more intelligently. Sider supports sidebar usage for anytime AI assistance.

name: 扣子
description_cn: 字节跳动的AI Agent开发平台
description_en: ByteDance's AI Agent development platform
detailed_description_cn: 扣子是字节跳动推出的新一代AI Agent开发平台，为用户提供快速创建AI应用的能力。无论是否有编程基础，都可以在扣子平台上快速搭建基于AI模型的各类问答Bot。平台提供丰富的插件和工具，支持多模态AI应用开发，是构建智能对话机器人的理想选择。
detailed_description_en: Coze is a next-generation AI Agent development platform launched by ByteDance, providing users with the ability to quickly create AI applications. Whether you have programming experience or not, you can quickly build various Q&A bots based on AI models on the Coze platform.

name: OpenAI Operator
description_cn: OpenAI的网页自动化AI代理
description_en: OpenAI's web automation AI agent
detailed_description_cn: OpenAI Operator是由OpenAI于2025年1月23日发布的人工智能代理，能够通过网页浏览器自主执行各种任务，包括填写表单、购物下单、安排预约等重复性的浏览器操作任务。Operator利用OpenAI的先进模型，扩展了用户在日常活动中的自动化应用能力，实施严格的数据保护协议和内建的安全检查机制。
detailed_description_en: OpenAI Operator is an AI agent released by OpenAI on January 23, 2025, capable of autonomously performing various tasks through web browsers, including form filling, online shopping, appointment scheduling, and other repetitive browser operations. Operator leverages OpenAI's advanced models to extend users' automation capabilities in daily activities.

name: 腾讯元宝
description_cn: 腾讯基于混元大模型的AI智能助手
description_en: Tencent's AI assistant based on Hunyuan model
detailed_description_cn: 腾讯元宝是腾讯于2024年5月30日推出的AI智能助手，基于自研的混元大模型，支持文案生成、图片生成和语音通话等功能。作为腾讯在AI领域的重要产品，元宝能够帮助用户进行多样化的内容创作和智能交互，提供高质量的AI服务体验。
detailed_description_en: Tencent Yuanbao is an AI intelligent assistant launched by Tencent on May 30, 2024, based on the self-developed Hunyuan large model. It supports functions such as copywriting generation, image generation, and voice calls, providing users with diversified content creation and intelligent interaction.

name: 通义千问3
description_cn: 阿里巴巴最新开源大语言模型
description_en: Alibaba's latest open-source large language model
detailed_description_cn: 通义千问3（Qwen3）是由阿里巴巴集团旗下阿里云于2025年4月29日开源的大型语言模型。Qwen3提供了多种尺寸的模型，适用于不同的应用场景，支持多语言处理，具备强大的文本生成和理解能力。作为开源模型，Qwen3为开发者提供了更多的自定义和部署选择。
detailed_description_en: Qwen3 is a large language model open-sourced by Alibaba Cloud on April 29, 2025. Qwen3 provides models of various sizes suitable for different application scenarios, supports multilingual processing, and has powerful text generation and understanding capabilities.

name: Imagen 3
description_cn: Google最新的文字转图像生成模型
description_en: Google's latest text-to-image generation model
detailed_description_cn: Imagen 3是由Google DeepMind于2024年8月13日发布的文字转图像模型，支持从文字提示生成高保真图像，提供多种风格和比例选择。Imagen 3在图像质量、文字理解和创意表现方面都有显著提升，能够生成更加逼真和富有创意的图像内容。
detailed_description_en: Imagen 3 is a text-to-image model released by Google DeepMind on August 13, 2024, supporting the generation of high-fidelity images from text prompts with various style and ratio options. Imagen 3 shows significant improvements in image quality, text understanding, and creative expression.

name: Kling AI
description_cn: 快手的图片转视频AI工具
description_en: Kuaishou's image-to-video AI tool
detailed_description_cn: Kling AI是快手推出的AI视频生成工具，其'Image to Video'功能在2025年迎来显著升级，支持更复杂的动画效果，并新增AI音效功能，提升视频的沉浸感。该工具能够将静态广告图像转化为动态展示视频，模拟产品旋转或环境变换的流畅效果，为内容创作者提供强大的视频制作能力。
detailed_description_en: Kling AI is an AI video generation tool launched by Kuaishou. Its 'Image to Video' function received significant upgrades in 2025, supporting more complex animation effects and adding AI sound effects to enhance video immersion. The tool can transform static advertising images into dynamic display videos.
pricing: 免费试用 + 付费订阅

name: Google Imagen 4
description_cn: Google最新的文字转图像生成模型
description_en: Google's latest text-to-image generation model
detailed_description_cn: Google Imagen 4是Google于2025年6月推出的最新文字到图像生成模型，在细节渲染与生成速度方面表现出色。作为Google在AI图像生成领域的最新突破，Imagen 4能够快速生成高质量图像，适合需要高效产出品牌宣传图像的创作者，满足社交媒体快速更新的需求。
detailed_description_en: Google Imagen 4 is the latest text-to-image generation model released by Google in June 2025, excelling in detail rendering and generation speed. As Google's latest breakthrough in AI image generation, Imagen 4 can quickly generate high-quality images, suitable for creators who need efficient production of high-quality brand promotional images.

name: Tubeclimb
description_cn: YouTube创作者专用SEO工具集
description_en: SEO toolkit for YouTube creators
detailed_description_cn: Tubeclimb是专为YouTube创作者和营销人员设计的全面SEO工具集，提供频道审核、标签生成器、关键词工具、排名追踪器等功能。该工具旨在帮助用户提升视频在YouTube和Google搜索中的排名，增加视频的推荐频率，提升观看量和关注度，是YouTube内容优化的专业解决方案。
detailed_description_en: Tubeclimb is a comprehensive SEO toolkit designed specifically for YouTube creators and marketers, offering features like channel auditing, tag generators, keyword tools, and ranking trackers. The tool aims to help users improve video rankings on YouTube and Google search, increase video recommendation frequency.

name: ImageToWhite
description_cn: 一键生成纯白背景的图片处理工具
description_en: One-click white background image processing tool
detailed_description_cn: ImageToWhite是一款专业的图片背景处理工具，能够一键生成纯白背景，提升电商图片质量。该工具特别适合需要高质量产品图片的电商平台和卖家，能够快速处理大量产品图片，确保图片背景的一致性和专业性，提升商品展示效果和销售转化率。
detailed_description_en: ImageToWhite is a professional image background processing tool that can generate pure white backgrounds with one click, improving e-commerce image quality. This tool is particularly suitable for e-commerce platforms and sellers who need high-quality product images.
pricing: 免费试用 + 付费订阅

name: JoggAI 2.0
description_cn: AI头像生成器
description_en: AI avatar generator
detailed_description_cn: JoggAI 2.0是一款先进的AI头像生成器，能够根据文本提示创建逼真的个性化AI头像。该工具利用最新的AI图像生成技术，为用户提供高质量、个性化的头像创作服务，适用于社交媒体、游戏、虚拟形象等多种应用场景，让每个用户都能拥有独特的数字形象。
detailed_description_en: JoggAI 2.0 is an advanced AI avatar generator that can create realistic personalized AI avatars based on text prompts. This tool utilizes the latest AI image generation technology to provide users with high-quality, personalized avatar creation services.
pricing: 免费试用 + 付费订阅

name: NewsBang
description_cn: AI驱动的新闻和洞察应用
description_en: AI-powered news and insights app
detailed_description_cn: NewsBang是一款AI驱动的新闻和洞察应用程序，提供个性化的新闻推荐和深度分析。该应用利用先进的AI算法分析用户兴趣和阅读习惯，为用户推送最相关的新闻内容，并提供智能洞察和趋势分析，帮助用户更好地理解复杂的新闻事件和市场动态。
detailed_description_en: NewsBang is an AI-driven news and insights application that provides personalized news recommendations and in-depth analysis. The app uses advanced AI algorithms to analyze user interests and reading habits, delivering the most relevant news content to users.

name: Needle
description_cn: 几秒钟内搜索所有数据的AI工具
description_en: AI tool that searches all data in seconds
detailed_description_cn: Needle是一款强大的AI搜索工具，能够在几秒钟内对所有数据进行搜索，大幅提升工作效率。该工具利用先进的AI技术和智能索引系统，能够快速检索和分析大量数据，为用户提供精准的搜索结果，是数据密集型工作环境中不可或缺的生产力工具。
detailed_description_en: Needle is a powerful AI search tool that can search all data within seconds, significantly improving work efficiency. This tool utilizes advanced AI technology and intelligent indexing systems to quickly retrieve and analyze large amounts of data.

name: Grok
description_cn: xAI开发的实时搜索AI助手
description_en: Real-time search AI assistant by xAI
detailed_description_cn: Grok是由Elon Musk创立的xAI公司于2024年推出的AI助手。它具备实时网络搜索能力，能够获取最新信息并提供准确回答。Grok以其幽默风趣的交互风格著称，深度集成于X(原Twitter)平台，支持多模态输入，是追求实时信息和独特AI体验用户的理想选择。
detailed_description_en: Grok is an AI assistant launched by xAI, the company founded by Elon Musk, in 2024. It features real-time web search capabilities, providing accurate answers with the latest information. Known for its witty interaction style and deep integration with X (formerly Twitter), Grok supports multimodal inputs.

name: Cursor
description_cn: AI驱动的智能代码编辑器
description_en: AI-powered intelligent code editor
detailed_description_cn: Cursor是2024年最受欢迎的AI代码编辑器之一，基于VS Code构建，深度集成了GPT-4等大语言模型。它能够理解整个代码库的上下文，提供智能代码补全、重构建议、Bug修复和代码解释。Cursor让开发者能够用自然语言描述需求，AI自动生成对应代码，极大提升开发效率。
detailed_description_en: Cursor is one of the most popular AI code editors in 2024, built on VS Code with deep integration of large language models like GPT-4. It understands the context of your entire codebase, providing intelligent code completion, refactoring suggestions, bug fixes, and code explanations.

name: Lovable
description_cn: 自然语言创建全栈Web应用
description_en: Create full-stack web apps with natural language
detailed_description_cn: Lovable（原GPT Engineer）是2024-2025年最火的AI应用开发平台之一。用户只需用自然语言描述想要的应用，Lovable就能自动生成完整的前后端代码、数据库和部署配置。它支持React、TypeScript等现代技术栈，让非技术人员也能快速构建专业级Web应用。
detailed_description_en: Lovable (formerly GPT Engineer) is one of the hottest AI app development platforms in 2024-2025. Users simply describe their desired application in natural language, and Lovable automatically generates complete frontend and backend code, database, and deployment configurations.
pricing: 免费试用 + 付费订阅

name: v0 by Vercel
description_cn: AI生成React UI组件
description_en: AI-generated React UI components
detailed_description_cn: v0是由Vercel推出的AI驱动的UI生成工具，能够根据文字描述自动生成高质量的React组件代码。它使用shadcn/ui和Tailwind CSS，生成的组件代码规范、可直接在项目中使用。v0是前端开发者快速原型设计和UI开发的得力助手，大幅缩短从设计到代码的时间。
detailed_description_en: v0 is an AI-powered UI generation tool by Vercel that automatically generates high-quality React component code from text descriptions. Using shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS, the generated components are production-ready and can be directly used in projects.

name: Gamma
description_cn: AI演示文稿和文档生成
description_en: AI presentation and document generation
detailed_description_cn: Gamma是一款革命性的AI演示文稿生成工具，让用户能够用自然语言快速创建精美的演示文稿、文档和网页。只需输入主题或大纲，Gamma就能自动生成专业设计的幻灯片，支持实时协作、嵌入多媒体和交互元素，是替代传统PPT的现代化解决方案。
detailed_description_en: Gamma is a revolutionary AI presentation generation tool that allows users to quickly create beautiful presentations, documents, and web pages using natural language. Simply input a topic or outline, and Gamma automatically generates professionally designed slides.

name: Synthesia
description_cn: AI数字人视频生成平台
description_en: AI avatar video generation platform
detailed_description_cn: Synthesia是全球领先的AI数字人视频生成平台，用户无需摄像头和演员，只需输入文本脚本，即可生成逼真的AI数字人视频。平台提供150+种AI头像和130+种语言支持，广泛应用于企业培训、产品介绍、营销视频等场景，被财富500强企业广泛采用。
detailed_description_en: Synthesia is a leading AI avatar video generation platform. Users can create realistic AI avatar videos simply by inputting text scripts, without cameras or actors. The platform offers 150+ AI avatars and 130+ language support, widely used by Fortune 500 companies.

name: HeyGen
description_cn: AI视频生成与多语言翻译
description_en: AI video generation and multilingual translation
detailed_description_cn: HeyGen是2024年快速崛起的AI视频生成平台，以其强大的视频翻译和口型同步功能著称。用户可以将视频自动翻译成40+种语言，AI会同步调整口型使其看起来像原生说该语言。此外，HeyGen还提供AI数字人生成、个性化头像克隆等功能，是跨国企业视频本地化的首选工具。
detailed_description_en: HeyGen is a rapidly rising AI video generation platform in 2024, known for its powerful video translation and lip-sync capabilities. Users can automatically translate videos into 40+ languages with synchronized lip movements. It's the go-to tool for multinational video localization.
pricing: 免费试用 + 付费订阅

name: Pika
description_cn: 创意AI视频生成工具
description_en: Creative AI video generation tool
detailed_description_cn: Pika是由斯坦福大学研究者创立的AI视频生成工具，以生成高质量、富有创意的短视频著称。用户可以通过文字描述、图片或视频输入，生成风格独特的动态视频内容。Pika的视频编辑功能也很强大，支持改变视频中物体的运动、添加特效等，是创意工作者的理想工具。
detailed_description_en: Pika is an AI video generation tool founded by Stanford researchers, known for creating high-quality, creative short videos. Users can generate unique dynamic video content through text descriptions, images, or video input, with powerful editing features.

name: Luma Dream Machine
description_cn: 高质量AI视频与3D内容生成
description_en: High-quality AI video and 3D content generation
detailed_description_cn: Luma Dream Machine是Luma AI推出的强大视频生成模型，能够从文本和图像快速生成高质量、逼真的视频内容。它特别擅长生成具有真实物理效果的场景，支持相机运动控制和3D一致性，每秒可生成120帧的流畅视频，是电影级视频创作的有力工具。
detailed_description_en: Luma Dream Machine is a powerful video generation model by Luma AI that can quickly generate high-quality, realistic video content from text and images. It excels at creating scenes with realistic physics, supporting camera motion control and 3D consistency.
pricing: 免费试用 + 付费订阅

name: ElevenLabs
description_cn: 专业级AI语音合成与克隆
description_en: Professional AI voice synthesis and cloning
detailed_description_cn: ElevenLabs是全球领先的AI语音合成平台，以其极度逼真的语音生成质量著称。平台提供文本转语音、语音克隆、实时语音转换等功能，支持29种语言。其语音克隆技术只需几分钟的音频样本就能创建高度相似的声音副本，被广泛应用于有声书、视频配音、播客等领域。
detailed_description_en: ElevenLabs is the world's leading AI voice synthesis platform, known for its extremely realistic voice generation. The platform offers text-to-speech, voice cloning, and real-time voice conversion, supporting 29 languages with industry-leading quality.

name: Udio
description_cn: 高质量AI音乐生成
description_en: High-quality AI music generation
detailed_description_cn: Udio是2024年推出的AI音乐生成平台，由前Google DeepMind研究者创立，被认为是Suno的强力竞争者。Udio能根据文字提示生成高质量的完整歌曲，包括人声、歌词和配乐，音质和音乐性都达到了专业水准。它支持多种音乐风格，是音乐创作者和内容创作者的利器。
detailed_description_en: Udio is an AI music generation platform launched in 2024, founded by former Google DeepMind researchers. It can generate high-quality complete songs with vocals, lyrics, and instrumentation from text prompts, rivaling professional production quality.

name: NotebookLM
description_cn: Google的AI笔记与研究助手
description_en: Google's AI note-taking and research assistant
detailed_description_cn: NotebookLM是Google推出的AI研究助手，能够帮助用户分析和理解复杂文档。用户可以上传PDF、文档、网页等资料，NotebookLM会自动提取关键信息、生成摘要、回答问题，甚至可以将内容转换为播客形式的音频对话。它是研究人员、学生和知识工作者的得力助手。
detailed_description_en: NotebookLM is Google's AI research assistant that helps users analyze and understand complex documents. Users can upload PDFs, documents, and web pages, and NotebookLM automatically extracts key information, generates summaries, and answers questions.

name: Bolt.new
description_cn: 浏览器内AI全栈开发环境
description_en: In-browser AI full-stack development environment
detailed_description_cn: Bolt.new是由StackBlitz推出的革命性AI开发平台，让用户能够在浏览器中通过自然语言对话构建完整的Web应用。无需本地开发环境，Bolt.new集成了AI代码生成、实时预览、包管理和一键部署功能，从想法到上线只需几分钟，是快速原型开发的最佳选择。
detailed_description_en: Bolt.new is a revolutionary AI development platform by StackBlitz that allows users to build complete web applications through natural language conversation in the browser. No local environment needed - from idea to deployment in minutes.

name: Replit Agent
description_cn: AI自主编程代理
description_en: Autonomous AI programming agent
detailed_description_cn: Replit Agent是Replit推出的AI编程代理，能够自主完成从项目创建到部署的整个开发流程。用户只需描述想要的应用功能，Agent会自动规划任务、编写代码、安装依赖、调试错误，直到应用成功运行。它代表了AI辅助编程的最新发展，让软件开发变得前所未有的简单。
detailed_description_en: Replit Agent is an AI programming agent that can autonomously complete the entire development workflow from project creation to deployment. Simply describe what you want, and Agent plans tasks, writes code, installs dependencies, and debugs until the app runs.

name: n8n
description_cn: 开源工作流自动化平台
description_en: Open-source workflow automation platform
detailed_description_cn: n8n是一个强大的开源工作流自动化平台，支持连接400+应用和服务。它特别适合AI工作流自动化，可以轻松集成各种AI模型和API，构建复杂的自动化流程。n8n提供可视化的工作流编辑器，支持自托管和云端部署，是Zapier的强大开源替代品，深受开发者和企业青睐。
detailed_description_en: n8n is a powerful open-source workflow automation platform supporting 400+ app integrations. It's especially suited for AI workflow automation, easily integrating various AI models and APIs. A popular open-source alternative to Zapier favored by developers.
pricing: 开源免费 + 云端付费
